# sendgrid_click_tracking_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide click tracking setting. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one click tracking configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_click_tracking_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether click tracking is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `enable_text` (Boolean) Whether click tracking is enabled for plain text emails. Read-only: SendGrid derives this from `enabled`.
- `id` (String) Always `click_tracking_settings`.
